dimensions.detail: The advertised URL shortening, analytics, organization, and team-management capabilities match the documented Zu.lk MCP tools. Account-impacting actions such as updating links and changing organization members are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions limit use to user-requested link, organization, member, and analytics workflows and tell the agent to verify the organization before changes. Stronger explicit confirmation guidance for member removal, role changes, and destination updates would be preferable.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is primarily a remote HTTPS MCP configuration. The included configure.sh only prints configuration text, while the optional stdio setup uses npx with a remote bridge package, which users should review or avoid unless needed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Internet access and Google OAuth to Zu.lk are expected for this remote service. The artifacts do not request broad local filesystem access, local indexing, background workers, or unrelated host privileges.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or credential-harvesting behavior is present. OAuth access will allow the agent to act on Zu.lk resources available to the connected account, including links, analytics, organizations, and member controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern about remote access to organization lists, member data, links, and analytics is valid as a privacy and consent note, but the artifact openly documents the Zu.lk MCP endpoint, OAuth flow, and these tool categories, and they fit the stated purpose.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns; local review found only documentation and a small configuration-printing script.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and aligned with artifact review, but was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
llm.guidance: Install only if you trust Zu.lk with the links, organization metadata, member information, and analytics you ask the agent to handle. Use the intended Google/Zu.lk account, prefer the direct HTTPS MCP configuration, and require explicit confirmation before changing link destinations, adding or removing members, or granting ADMIN/OWNER roles.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed Zu.lk URL-shortener integration, but it can access and change organization links, analytics, and membership after OAuth sign-in.

The skill bundle provides a legitimate integration for the Zu.lk URL shortening service via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The included files consist of tool definitions for link management and analytics, a helper script (scripts/configure.sh) that safely prints configuration instructions for the user, and standard documentation; no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found.
